source: NASADEM 30 m (NASA JPL), via Microsoft Planetary Computer; NASADEM_HGT_n25e089

method.relativeElevation: elevation minus median in a ~1 km square; then Gaussian smoothing
method.alpha: 0.25 at -1 m; linear to 0.75 at <= -3 m; Gaussian alpha blur sigma 1 cell; outer 4 cells feathered
method.rim: 1 low-side cell at -1 m contour; #5f9fed; alpha +0.1
method.grid: 200x200, north to south; l: below -1 m, e: -1 to +1 m, h: above +1 m

caveat: Approximate (30 m, includes trees and buildings). Relative surface height, not flood prediction or drainage advice.
